visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. He holds a black rectangular box containing a black and white humanoid robot figure. Large red and white text overlays appear on the top half of the screen. (2) Close-up shot of the white and black robot figure standing alone on a wooden table, holding a black accessory rod. The lighting is soft and even. (3) The man is back on screen, gesturing with his hands as he talks while holding the product box. Behind him is a blurred living room background with curtains and a picture frame. (4) Close-up of the back of the box, showing the silver Tesla logo and the white text 'Made On Earth By Humans' against a dark gray background with stylized light rays. (5) Detailed shots show the man's hands manipulating the robot's limbs, testing the articulation of the elbows, knees, and fingers. (6) The man sets the robot on the table in a dynamic high-kick pose, demonstrating its balance. He then shows a small white and black charging station model accessory. (7) Finally, he attaches a black base support to the robot's back and continues speaking enthusiastically to the camera.
